Subject: Next steps: Technical deep dive & proposed recurring windows

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can lock in a technical deep dive: 

Highlights from the discovery call:
- Primary goal: embed low-latency summarization into your clinician dashboard (existing EHR integration).
- Current constraints: HIPAA-sensitive data, on-premise staging for pilot, target 99th p95 latency <= 250ms for short queries.
- Stakeholders for the deep dive: Platform (you), Integration lead (Samantha), Security (TBD), and our solution engineer (Vanessa).

Proposed next step: 45–60 minute technical deep dive and integration workshop where we can:
- Walk through the integration checklist and latency targets.
- Demo a short run using a representative prompt set.
- Confirm network/KMS requirements for Private deployment options.

Because you mentioned a global team, I put together a small set of recurring window options we can use for the follow-up series (we recommend rotating windows so the Atlas team in EU/APAC shares after-hours burden). Please confirm which of these work for you, or share a few alternatives and your preferred timezone:

Option A (US-friendly first):
- Tue/Thu 09:00–10:00 PT (US west morning) — good for Diego/Vanessa 
- Wed 17:00–18:00 CET (EU late afternoon) — alternates with US slots 
- Thu 08:00–09:00 SGT (APAC morning) — once/week rotation

Option B (Even rotation):
- Mon 08:30–09:15 PT / Mon 17:30–18:15 CET / Tue 09:00–09:45 SGT 

I attached a short proposed agenda (deepdive-agenda.pdf) and our integration checklist (mvp-integration-checklist.xlsx) to help you prepare.

Next steps: can you (or Samantha) pick one of the options above or paste 3 slot preferences? I’ll send a recurring invite and include Vanessa and Monica.

Thanks — Diego

--

Diego — thanks for the detailed recap and the artifacts. Samantha is looping in to help with scheduling. A couple quick clarifications before we lock a recurring series: 

- Security: our security lead (I'll introduce next thread) needs to validate network egress and KMS approach.
- Pilot dataset: we'll start with deidentified test records in the staging environment; timeline target is mid-November for a two-week pilot.

Samantha — are any of the option slots Diego listed workable for Atlas? If not, here are 3 alternatives that map to our team's availability (all CET):
1) Wed 16:00–17:00 CET (this week works)
2) Thu 09:00–10:00 CET (better for our integration engineer)
3) Fri 07:00–08:00 CET (early but possible)

If you can propose the session as a recurring invite that alternates the windows (we prefer an even-rotation approach so the ops folks don't always get the late calls), we can pick the final cadence.

Best — Alex
